en: The postcard depicts an ornate, historic train station with a tall clock tower and arched windows. Several horse-drawn carriages are lined up in front of the building, and people are visible walking around. The style is black and white, with a vintage feel typical of early 20th-century postcards. The text 'BRUGES. — La Gare' is printed at the top, and on the left edge, 'Aux Galeries Brugeoises, 5, Dyer, Bruges' is visible.
